questions.text: What type of project experience does this course center on?
options: A simulated / paper-based IT project management case study
questions.explanation: The course is a Simulated / Paper-Based IT Project Management Case Study.

questions.text: In the simulation, what role do student teams take on?
questions.explanation: Students act as the Project Management Team (PMO / PMs) for a complex, realistic enterprise IT initiative.

questions.text: Which of the following are listed as real-world IT enterprise scenarios teams may select or be assigned?
questions.explanation: The four listed scenarios are Enterprise Cloud Migration, Fintech / Digital Payment Integration, Campus-Wide Smart Campus / IoT Infrastructure, and Data Platform & Business Intelligence Rollout. Video Game Development is not one of them.

questions.text: The Fintech / Digital Payment Integration scenario example involves adding which features to an existing retail app?
options: Multi-factor authentication, e-wallet processing, and fraud detection
questions.explanation: The example given is adding multi-factor authentication, e-wallet processing, and fraud detection to an existing retail app.

questions.text: The Campus-Wide Smart Campus / IoT scenario example includes automated attendance, turnstiles, and ___ management systems.
questions.explanation: The example describes "Automated attendance, turnstiles, and facility management system."

questions.text: Match each PMO / Project Steering Committee role to its primary deliverables.
allChoices: Business Case, Project Charter, Change Control / Requests, Final Presentation
Scope Statement, Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM), WBS & WBS Dictionary
Activity List, Network Diagram, Gantt Chart (Schedule), Resource Allocation
Cost Estimates, Budget Baseline, Quality Control Tools (Fishbone, Pareto)
Stakeholder Register & Plan, Risk Register & Matrix, Risk Response Strategy

questions.explanation: Each PMO role maps to a distinct set of deliverables per the course's team-role table.

questions.text: Which PMO role is responsible for the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM)?
questions.explanation: The Scope & Requirements Lead owns the Scope Statement, RTM, and WBS & WBS Dictionary.

questions.text: Which PMO role produces the Network Diagram and Gantt Chart?
questions.explanation: The Schedule & Resource Lead produces the Activity List, Network Diagram, Gantt Chart, and Resource Allocation.

questions.text: Which PMO role applies Quality Control tools like Fishbone diagrams and Pareto analysis?
questions.explanation: The Cost & Quality Lead owns Cost Estimates, Budget Baseline, and Quality Control Tools (Fishbone, Pareto).

questions.text: Which PMO role owns the Risk Register & Matrix and Risk Response Strategy?
questions.explanation: The Risk & Stakeholder Lead owns the Stakeholder Register & Plan, Risk Register & Matrix, and Risk Response Strategy.

questions.text: Which PMO role is responsible for the Business Case, Project Charter, and Final Presentation?
questions.explanation: The Project Manager / Integration Lead owns the Business Case, Project Charter, Change Control / Requests, and Final Presentation.

questions.text: Which of the following IT Program Outcomes are the project scenarios explicitly aligned to?
questions.explanation: The scenarios are aligned to IT Program Outcomes IT05, IT06, IT07, and IT09. IT08 is not mentioned.

questions.text: Per the 2026 estimated salary chart, which IT role has the highest senior-level (6+ yrs) monthly gross salary range?
questions.explanation: IT Project Manager has the highest listed senior-level range at PHP 127,000 - 190,000.

questions.text: Which IT role has the lowest listed junior-level (0-2 yrs) salary range in the 2026 chart?
questions.explanation: QA Engineer has the lowest junior-level range at PHP 26,000 - 42,000.

questions.text: The Enterprise Cloud Migration scenario example includes migrating a legacy university portal or hospital record system to AWS/Azure.
questions.explanation: The example given is "Migrating a legacy university portal or hospital record system to AWS/Azure."
